method: Opened official upstream pages with web tools; paraphrased observations, not source snapshots. Sufficiency judgments are reviewer inferences.
limits: Moving online references, no upstream commit/hash pin or installed-version/live inspection. Freedesktop rendered pages returned 403; raw project manuals used.

sources.observation: Transient start and job monitoring; effective properties and main-process observations; no documented application reservation/terminal transaction.
Separate startup/runtime/stop controls, runtime extension and randomization caveats.
Job timeout does not itself change unit state; unloading loses execution results except logging.
Scheduling/coalescing and timer slack do not establish the required whole-transaction deadline.
Runtime-cycle token is shared by unit processes, not an individual process identity.
Unit hierarchy resource controls and delegated subgroup placement; not per-request external-manager attribution.
Waits for synchronization of earlier messages; no finite bound specified for that operation.
Default periodic sync is five minutes; storage and retention configuration affect evidence.
Reception timestamps are not persistence-completion timestamps.
Acknowledges processing of previous notifications, not application disk commit.
Hierarchical scope, zombie omission from membership, live-population semantics.
Direct creation into a frozen cgroup and pidfd acquisition are documented primitives.
Stable descriptor, exit polling and direct-child waiting have distinct semantics.
Suspend treatment differs; do not silently mix clocks.
File synchronization may require directory synchronization, may block/fail, has no timeout argument.
High effort supported; availability also checked against session catalog, no account-access inference.
